escena: SCENE (project review, studio in Santiago, late afternoon): a hard low sun beam through a side window falls ONTO THE TWO PEOPLE across the table, leaving the near side of the room in shadow; the photograph is taken FROM THE EMPTY SEAT AT THE HEAD OF THE TABLE — the viewer's own chair — so the camera sits at seated eye level and the two of them face it from the far side, mid-conversation: she is sliding a printed layout across the table towards the viewer at the exact moment it leaves her fingers, and he is already leaning in to explain it. He wears a faded olive linen shirt with the sleeves rolled; she wears a fine light heather-grey knit sweater; no jackets, no navy or blue clothing. They look at the layout and at each other, never into the lens. 50mm lens at f/2, seated eye level, focus on the layout and her hands. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the top of the backrest of the empty chair in front of the camera, dark charcoal fabric, a soft gentle curve, in shadow
